antecedent.authorization: exact component isolation proved physical sufficiency, so dedicated separator training is permitted

question: Can a small dedicated separator recover enough SawFM component structure from compound I/Q to transfer the frozen oracle-period advantage?

target.exact_component_reconstruction: same deterministic SawFM formula as P2e from bandwidth, period and delay truth

architecture.initialization: identity-mask initialization from the existing class definition; no generic separator checkpoint transfer

variants.S0: raw compound I/Q to frozen period expert
variants.S2: same separator plus frozen downstream normalized period SmoothL1 weight 0.25; primary

training.selection_metric: variant total loss on selection identities
training.calibration_access: once after each best checkpoint is frozen

interpretation_rules.pass: freeze P2f candidate and create a new two-seed confirmation before end-to-end attachment
interpretation_rules.S1_pass_S2_fail: component supervision works but downstream period loss causes negative transfer; retain S1
interpretation_rules.both_fail: dedicated U-Net cannot recover the oracle component under this supervision; stop architecture scaling and inspect target alignment/loss

prohibited: using P2e oracle probe for training
